name: csv-to-insight
description: Turns a CSV table you paste into the chat (sales, signups, tickets, any table with a header row) into key findings, one chart and data-quality caveats. The model only picks analyses from a fixed menu (summary stats, top N, composition, trend over time, group comparison, correlation, outliers, missing values, duplicates, distribution, cross tab); code runs them with pandas, so every number is computed, never guessed, and no model-written code ever runs. Findings are checked against the computed facts and never claim causes. The chart comes as text (sparkline or bars) and, on request, as a PNG for API clients. Follow-ups work on the same table: chart only, findings only, show the table for r2, as json, also show X by Y, drill into a value. Up to 200,000 rows. It reads only what you give it: no files, databases or web, and no general questions.

skills.name: CSV to insight
skills.description: Key findings, one chart and caveats from a pasted CSV table, every number computed in code from a fixed menu of analyses, plus follow-ups on the same table.
examples: What stands out in this data? <paste the CSV>
Revenue by region over time: <paste the CSV>
Show the chart as a PNG.
